# shipd_service_account_token (Resource)

Registers a workload token on an existing shipd service account. The token must expire. Destroy revokes it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "worker_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
  default   = null
}

resource "shipd_service_account_token" "worker" {
  id                 = "ea76a78c-21a5-4e39-876a-27af888bf220"
  organization_id    = "org-id"
  service_account_id = "service-account-id"
  project_id         = "project-id"
  name               = "Worker"
  scopes             = { project = ["read"] }
  expires_at         = var.worker_token_expiry
  secret_wo          = var.worker_token
}

variable "worker_token_expiry" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) A stable, lowercase UUIDv4 for this credential generation. Use a fresh UUID and secret for every replacement.
- `name` (String) The workload token's display name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the credential.
- `scopes` (Map of Set of String) Explicit resource-to-verb scope map. The issuer must hold every requested scope.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account that owns the workload token.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `environment_id` (String) Optional environment binding within the project.
- `project_id` (String) Optional project binding. Omit for an organization-wide token.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Externally generated shipd credential with an organization tag. Required on creation and replacement. Supply it from a secret store through an ephemeral variable. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.

### Read-Only

- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether shipd has revoked the credential.
